One task socket survives switches and updates all visited views
User Gantt ceiling and disabled child direct URLs are enforced
Hidden-only tab keeps established direct-access semantics
Sidebar Management groups all four task tabs separately

Notification UUID deep links preserve filters and open existing Task Details
